title: feat(console): send back for revision in the approvals inbox (ADR-0044)
body:
Console counterpart of [framework#1769](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/framework/pull/1769) (closes the UI half of framework#1744).

## What

- **Approver**: "Send back" button (violet, between Reject and Request info) with its own dialog explaining the semantics — this round ends as `returned`, the record unlocks, resubmission opens a fresh round for all approvers. Auto-reject toast when the server reports the `maxRevisions` budget exceeded.
- **Submitter**: a returned request shows a revision panel — unlocked-record hint, edit-record link, optional comment, **Resubmit** (opens round N+1) and **Recall** (abandons the revision window; server cancels the parked run).
- `returned` status: violet badge + status-filter option; **Round N** chips on list rows and the drawer strip (`row.round`); timeline renders `revise` (violet) / `resubmit` (blue) audit entries.
- `approvalsApi.sendBack/resubmit`; row typings gain `returned` + `round`.
- `approvalsInbox` i18n: 18 new keys across all ten locales (locale-parity tests green).

## Verification

- console: 3521 tests ✓, tsc clean; i18n: 100 ✓
- Browser end-to-end against the framework showcase stack: send back (dialog → violet badge + timeline entry) → record unlocks → resubmit from the submitter panel → Round 2 chip + fresh trail → approve; third send-back auto-rejects with the audit trail `revise → reject ("Auto-rejected: revision limit (2) exceeded")`.
